description:
About the company
 Our client is a small holding company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build AI-driven tools and product features for clients, the sales team and internal use. Take loosely defined technical problems from start to finish, deciding the scope and shipping without much direction. The work spans client delivery, go-to-market tooling and internal systems, and shifts with what the business needs each week. A large share of the week goes to hands-on delivery for clients, frequently with an outside engineering group.
 What you'll do
 - Build and refine tools that help the sales team find and reach prospective customers.
 - Ship features and fixes for clients the team already works with.
 - Improve internal tooling so it can be reused across projects instead of rebuilt each time.
 - Take unclear client issues or unfinished platform features, define the scope and deliver the result with little oversight.
 - Work alongside the platform lead on AI agent code, and specialize over time in the area that suits you best.
 - Travel occasionally for client kickoffs, usually for one to two days.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Hands-on experience delivering AI software that goes past simple conversational prototypes, such as data-driven assistants or applications used by outside users.
 - Clear written and verbal communication, since you will interact with clients regularly.
 - Experience working directly with a client, end user or non-technical stakeholder to scope and deliver a finished product.
 - Broad full-stack ability across product, data and engineering.
 - Strong coding skills with and without AI assistance, and the judgment to spot faulty agent outputs.
 - Works with AI agent tools as the normal way of writing software day to day.
 Bonus points
 - Degree in computer science from a top-50 university.
 - Previous work building AI-powered tools for an employer or paying customer in any capacity.
 - Track record of shipping production code with minimal supervision.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 140,000 to 165,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Los Angeles, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days a week
 - Full-time
